title: Bank of England MPC decision + Monetary Policy Report — the committee that must forecast the electricity-VAT reversion four weeks after it happens and seven weeks before any print shows it
source: EST: bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy/upcoming-mpc-dates, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the 2027 schedule lists 'Thursday 29 April' as an announcement accompanied by a Monetary Policy Report, one of four MPR meetings in 2027 (4 February, 29 April, 29 July, 4 November). The Bank labels its 2027 dates PROVISIONAL, which is the honest reason for `estimate` on top of the standing schema gap: market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:) has no slot for a non-US central bank. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01 LANE, 2026-09-09, for a sequencing reason that is unusually clean and repeats a pattern the sibling uk-electricity-vat-zero-rate-2026-10-01 lane found on the way down. Laid against the ONS release calendar (fetched the same day), the order around the 2027-04-01 lapse is: MPC 2027-03-18 (no report, pre-lapse) -> the lapse 2027-04-01 -> March 2027 CPI 2027-04-21 (still drag-in) -> THIS MEETING, which must publish an MPR forecast EMBEDDING the reversion having seen NO post-reversion data -> April 2027 CPI 2027-05-19, the first observation -> MPC 2027-06-17, the first committee to actually see it. Forecast and observation are seven weeks apart, exactly as they were around the October 2026 cut (the November 2026 MPR embedded it; the October print landed after the 2026-11-05 vote). THE INFERENCE THE PROPOSING LANE DRAWS, AND IT IS A LOOK-THROUGH ARGUMENT NOT A RATE CALL: a self-reversing tax notch whose forecast and observation never coincide is exactly what a committee looks through. It moves printed numbers; it is materially weaker evidence about the rate path than its headline size suggests. This meeting is the venue where an MPR that books the +0.09 to +0.13pp step would first be visible in the forecast profile. NO DIRECTIONAL VIEW ON BANK RATE IS REGISTERED HERE -- the proposing lane researched a VAT reversion, not UK monetary policy, and has no MPC forward test. Tiered LOW: symbols: [], and this calendar's entire tracked universe is eight US mega-caps with no UK listing, gilt or sterling instrument; the only transmission channel this repo has ever measured is the gilt-to-Treasury pipe quantified in uk-autumn-budget-2026-10-28, which opens only on the worst ~1% of gilt days. Estimate widens caution only; the Bank's own 2027 dates are provisional and should be re-checked against its published calendar before anything is keyed to them.
